text: {"lessons":["I will avoid selling winners merely to lock in a gain; I’ll base each sale on a clear change in prospects or a pre-set plan.","I will not chase a stock after selling it or buy simply because its price has risen; I’ll reassess its value and risks first.","I will size purchases carefully and set an exit plan in advance, so fear of admitting a mistake does not keep me in a losing position—or prompt a rushed sale."]}
